eggs.line: Yuuko: That is not a binding. That is a cry for help with an equals sign.
Yuuko: A word in a num's clothing. Even I cannot grade this curve.
Hangar: You called a task that was never built. The hangar is empty.
Cockpit: Index ninety-nine on a three-ship formation. Bold. Wrong.
Ministry: Two anime prefixes walk into a compiler. Both are audited.

rule: Easter-egg lines fire ONLY on byte-exact match of the full source text against exact_source AND only after the source is already known-invalid for the paired code (or, when code is null, after any failed check). They never fire for any other source, including near-misses that differ by whitespace, case, or a single character.
